en: Color postcard showing a central square with a large bronze statue of a robed man standing on an ornate stone pedestal decorated with allegorical female figures and inscriptions. The monument is surrounded by wreaths and ribbons. Behind it are multi‑story buildings with green shutters and shop awnings, and a clock tower with battlements. At the top of the image is a printed caption indicating the location and subject of the monument.
